neighbours.label: The quantity that an experiment varies or a plot takes as its independent variable ('X versus', 'plotted against', 'was varied from', 'increasing amounts of'), not the same lab quantities merely mentioned.
fire: The acid was titrated, and we graphed pH versus volume of titrant.
Emission intensity was plotted against laser power for all the films.
The chamber pressure was varied between 1 and 20 mbar.
Rats received increasing amounts of zinc in their feed.
Growth rate depends linearly on the weight fraction of filler.
The film was annealed at temperatures varied from 300 to 600 K.
The current was measured as a function of applied voltage.
quiet: The acid was stored in a locked cabinet next to the titrant.
Emission intensity was low, and the laser was sent for repair.
The chamber pressure was 5 mbar when the pump failed.
Rats received their feed in the morning from a technician.
Growth of the company depends on the sale of filler.
The film was kept in a dark drawer at room temperature.
The current supervisor of the lab retired last year.

notes: Top examples: 'pH versus Vb', 'increasing quantities', 'pressure was varied', plt.xlabel. Near misses keep the same lab nouns with nothing being varied.
